title: An averaging method for periodic solutions of quasilinear equations in Banach spaces
summary: The aim of the paper is to provide an extension of the averaging method to the periodic problem for quasilinear differential equations $(φ(t,u'))' = \varepsilon f(t,u,u',\varepsilon)$, $u(0) = u(T)$, $u'(0) = u'(T)$, where $u$ and $u'$ take values in a Banach space $X$ and $φ$ is a suitable homeomorphism between a neighborhood of $0$ in $X$ and $X$.
